about:
Ryobi Die Casting (USA), Inc. operates a manufacturing campus in Shelbyville, Indiana, as the North American arm of Japan-based Ryobi Limited. The facility serves as the company's primary U.S. production site.

The company specializes in the development and manufacture of complex aluminum die castings for structural automotive applications. Its in-house capabilities span research and development, die design, product design support, and process engineering. The Shelbyville campus employs more than 700 people and supports high-volume production of technically demanding castings.

Ryobi's customer base is the global automotive industry. The company has been recognized by Honda with a 2022 Excellence in Delivery and Quality award and by General Motors as a Supplier of the Year honoree, indicating long-standing relationships with major OEMs.

Ryobi states its mission is to win the superior confidence of the die casting market through responsibility, quality communication, and service to internal and external customers. Its values emphasize communication, change, challenge, and commitment, reflecting a culture focused on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.
